name: shared
description: Gate 3 (U7): the oracle's frozen outcomes for the shared scope: a seeded sample of mutants with strata top-ups, the oracle class of every mutant (U13 command run) and the per-test outcome of every sampled mutant with every test, each test launched alone (U12). Check a vitest5 runner run with `npm run test:mutation:oracle -- --scope test/fixtures/mutation-oracle/shared.json,<results.json>` (from gitnexus/). When gate 3 reports "re-freeze required", run the refreeze command.
refreeze: npm run test:mutation:oracle:freeze -- --from-manifest test/fixtures/mutation-oracle/shared.json --seed <new seed> --work <dir outside the checkout>

sample.method: sha256(seed + "\n" + globalId) ascending; the size lowest ranks, then strata top-ups
